utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m checking the timing and supplies for Saturday, so I’d appreciate any extra hands you can point me to.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ve moved the repair drive to Sunday at the community center, and I’m lining up a few helpers now. I’ll send you the supplies list and exact timing so you have the concrete details.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Sam. Can you send me their names so I can line up the Saturday porch work?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m still lining up a few handy helpers for the repair drive this Saturday on the front porch. If you know anyone else who can swing a hammer or lend a hand, send them my way!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, Saturday at 9 on the front porch — I’ll be there and help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Oren. Nine on the front porch works, and I’ll have the tools sorted when you get here.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’d be glad to send a few handy folks your way for Saturday’s porch repair drive. Hope it gets the help it needs!

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that’d be wonderful, Sam — thank you! Send anyone handy my way, and I’ll make sure they have something useful to do on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Vik. I’ll have the tools ready when you get here Saturday out front.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll be there Saturday out front and I’ll keep asking around for a few more handy helpers.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’m still lining up a few handy helpers for the repair drive this Saturday on the front porch, so if you know anyone else who can swing a hammer or lend a hand, send them my way!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing, Tess. I’ll send anyone handy your way and I’ll keep Saturday morning at 9 on the front porch in mind.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, Mina — I’ll send any handy folks your way for the porch repair drive this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Sam. Send anyone handy my way if you hear of them.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
